title: Exit Ticket: Lesson {lesson} "{session_title}"
description:
Welcome to the Exit Ticket, a weekly, post-session ritual, that serves several purposes for both you and the Civics Unplugged program team! This form will only be open for 10 minutes post-session and should take ~ 5 minutes to complete.

Submission of this form not only marks your attendance, but is also an opportunity to:
1. Reflect on, interrogate, and reinforce your learnings
2. Contribute to real time Fellowship improvement
The CU Team values your feedback deeply and believes in collective creation. While some facets of the Fellowship are set in stone, your responses will help inform in-program changes, such as session structure and our approach to topic investigation. To this end, please be as honest and thoughtful as possible so that we can best serve you!

If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out to Adiah on Slack or via email (adiah@civicsunplugged.org)

questions.title: How would you rate today's session?
What was your biggest takeaway from Lesson {lesson}?
What would you like to see more of in next week's lesson?
What would you like to see less of in next week's lesson?
What question(s) do you still have after today's discussion?
questions.description: This can include questions about a specific case study, broader implications, the Fellowship in general, etc.
